hooks.name: Secrets guard
hooks.description: After any save, ask the agent to confirm no secrets or hardcoded keys were introduced

action.prompt: Scan the file that was just saved for API keys, AWS access keys, tokens, passwords, or hardcoded model prices outside pricing.py. If any are found, remove them, move the value to an environment variable, and tell Tejaswi exactly what you changed. If none, say nothing.
